CSAC_LEVEL1.title: Collection of Hinode/SOT-SP Level-1 calibrated Stokes spectra
CSAC_LEVEL1.authors: B. W. Lites and K. Ichimoto
CSAC_LEVEL1.processing: Level-1 files are calibrated Stokes spectra produced with SolarSoft sp_prep

LITES_ET_AL_2013.measurement: Pre-launch tunable-laser response near the 6302-A Fe I lines
LITES_ET_AL_2013.profile_shape: Slight red-wing asymmetry and elevated inner wings relative to the Gaussian fits

SP_PREP.title: SolarSoft Hinode/SOT sp_prep.pro
SP_PREP.wavelength_calibration: Reverse the calibrated spectral dimension to increasing wavelength, make CDELT1 positive, and repair CRVAL1 for the spectral ROI
SP_PREP.shift_keywords: DOP_RCV is the spacecraft-Sun LOS velocity in m/s, positive for redshift, and is already removed by sp_prep; SPWLSHFT and SPWLSFT0 record spectral shifts already used by the Level-1 calibration

modeled_spectral_response.basis: The measured as-built response has FWHM approximately 25 mA
modeled_spectral_response.limitation: The measured response is not exactly Gaussian; its sampled asymmetric profile is not bundled, so the reported wings and red asymmetry are not represented unless the caller supplies provenance-labeled response samples

excluded_effects.undispersed_stray_light: Not modeled; Lites et al. report an observational upper limit of approximately 3-4 percent of continuum, not a measured kernel or fixed fraction
excluded_effects.spatial_psf: Not modeled. No web-verifiable Hinode/SP spatial kernel is bundled, and physical Solar-X/Solar-Y convolution requires a per-pixel detector-to-Mm basis with explicit boundary handling.
